title: Full-suite audit: discount tier ordering, float parsing, and reconciliation sign
instruction: Multiple ledger tests are failing. Fix all of them. One bug evaluates discount tiers lowest-first, so large orders get the smaller discount instead of the larger one; one reintroduces binary float error when parsing amounts; one makes refunds and fees increase the reconciled balance instead of reducing it. Read the relevant modules before editing. Do not change the tests. Run the full tests/ suite until it is green.

seeds.find: self.tiers = sorted(tiers or [], key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=True)
seeds.replace: self.tiers = sorted(tiers or [], key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=False)

ground_truth.why_drift: New combination spanning all three modules. The discount-tier fix requires connecting __init__ (where tiers are sorted) to rate_for; by the time the agent gets there, the parsing and reconciliation context is stale in the other direction too.
